data_proof.fingerprint_method: MD5 over canonical JSONB rows with original source column set; sorted complete row text; counts included

payload_redacted.method: Only hashes, model provenance, usage, states and mechanical check booleans; no prompts/manuscript/output text

lock_revision_proof.method: read-only count within original project/root, excluding original base row and explicit lock metadata row

canary_proof.scope: Only declared M5-R8/M5-Q7 canaries in actor generator prompts; not an independent full knowledge-quality judgment

verification.docs_impact_review: existing --no-change-reason mechanism; architecture readmap and maintenance process unchanged
verification.independent_review: engineering_audit final source review plus parent integration; known prepare P2 fixed and regression passed

final_source.after_quality_run_change: prepare rejects known confirmation/budget/intent errors before side-effect apply; guard regression only
